function.name: PALETTE_Init
function.description: This function initializes a palette with 20 default system colors.
function.return_type: HPALETTE, which represents the handle to the newly created palette

function.name: NtGdiCreatePaletteInternal
function.description: This function creates a palette object and returns a handle to it. It allocates memory for the palette object and its entries, copies the entries from the input palette, and assigns the handle to the palette object.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGPALETTE structure that contains information about the colors in the logical palette.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of entries in the logical palette.

function.return_type: HPALETTE. It represents a handle to the newly created palette object. If the function fails, the return value is NULL.

function.name: NtGdiCreateHalftonePalette
function.description: This function creates a halftone palette using the default color table and returns a handle to the palette.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

function.return_type: HPALETTE, a handle to the created halftone palette.

function.name: get_palette_entries
function.description: This function retrieves a specified range of palette entries from a given palette object.

parameters.name: hpalette
parameters.description: Handle to the palette object.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The first entry in the palette to be retrieved.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of palette entries to be retrieved.

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of PALETTEENTRY structures to receive the palette entries.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of entries retrieved from the palette.

function.name: set_palette_entries
function.description: This function sets the color palette entries for a given palette. It returns the number of entries that were successfully set.

parameters.name: hpalette
parameters.description: Handle to the palette to be modified.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The starting index where the setting of palette entries should begin.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of palette entries to be set.

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of PALETTEENTRY structures that contain the color data to set.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of palette entries that were successfully set.

function.name: NtGdiResizePalette
function.description: This function resizes a palette by reallocating memory for the palette entries and updating the count of entries. If the new count is greater than the previous count, the additional entries are initialized to zero.

parameters.name: hPal
parameters.description: Handle to the palette to be resized.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: New count of entries in the palette.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the palette was successfully resized. Returns TRUE if successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: animate_palette
function.description: This function animates a palette by changing its colors. It only animates colors that are marked as PC_RESERVED. If the palette is the default one, no animation is performed.

parameters.name: hPal
parameters.description: Handle to the logical palette to animate.

parameters.name: StartIndex
parameters.description: The starting index of the entries in the logical palette to animate.

parameters.name: NumEntries
parameters.description: The number of entries in the logical palette to animate.

parameters.name: PaletteColors
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of PALETTEENTRY structures that contains the new color data for the palette.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the palette was successfully animated, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: NtGdiSetSystemPaletteUse
function.description: This function sets the system palette use and returns the previous system palette use. If the device doesn't support colour palettes, it returns an error.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: use
parameters.description: Specifies how the system palette is to be used.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the previous system palette use. If the device doesn't support colour palettes, it returns SYSPAL_ERROR.

function.name: NtGdiGetSystemPaletteUse
function.description: This function is used to get the system palette use.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle to the device context.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the current system palette use.

function.name: get_system_palette_entries
function.description: This function retrieves the system palette entries from the specified device context and stores them in the provided entries array.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The first entry in the system palette table to be retrieved.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of palette entries to be retrieved.

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of PALETTEENTRY structures to receive the palette entries.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of entries in the logical palette.

function.name: nulldrv_GetSystemPaletteEntries
function.description: This function is designed to get the system palette entries but currently it returns 0 and does nothing.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Device context

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The first entry to be retrieved

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of entries to be retrieved

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the palette entries

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of entries retrieved, but currently always returns 0

function.name: NtGdiGetNearestPaletteIndex
function.description: This function retrieves the index of the entry in the logical palette most closely matching a specified color value.

parameters.name: hpalette
parameters.description: Handle to the logical palette.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Specifies the color to be matched.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the index of the entry in the logical palette that most closely matches the specified color value.

function.name: nulldrv_GetNearestColor
function.description: This function retrieves the nearest color from the specified device context's current logical palette to the specified color reference. If the device context is not using a palette, the function returns the specified color.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the device context.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: This is the color reference for which the function finds the nearest color.

function.return_type: COLORREF, which represents the nearest color in the logical palette to the specified color. If the device context is not using a palette, the function returns the specified color.

function.name: NtGdiGetNearestColor
function.description: This function retrieves the color in the current logical palette that most closely matches a specified color.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Specifies the color to be matched.

function.return_type: COLORREF, represents the RGB color value that is closest to the specified color.

function.name: PALETTE_GetObject
function.description: This function retrieves the count of palette entries and copies it to the buffer if it exists. If the buffer doesn't exist, it sets the count to the size of WORD. It then releases the handle to the GDI object.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the GDI object

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of palette entries

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the count will be copied

function.return_type: INT, represents the count of palette entries

function.name: PALETTE_UnrealizeObject
function.description: This function unrealizes a palette object and releases the handle to it.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the GDI object.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE indicating the function has successfully executed.

function.name: PALETTE_DeleteObject
function.description: This function deletes a palette object, freeing the associated memory.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the palette object to be deleted.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the object was successfully deleted, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: NtUserSelectPalette
function.description: This function selects a palette into the specified device context and updates the colors in the device context to match the colors in the selected palette.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: hpal
parameters.description: Handle to the logical palette to be selected.

parameters.name: bkg
parameters.description: Specifies whether the palette is background or foreground. If this parameter is zero, the palette is in the foreground.

function.return_type: HPALETTE. Returns the previous logical palette if the function is successful. Otherwise, it returns zero.

function.name: NtUserRealizePalette
function.description: This function realizes a logical palette, which means it maps the colors in the logical palette to the system palette. It also sends a palette change notification if colors were changed.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to the device context.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of entries in the logical palette that were mapped to the system palette.

function.name: NtGdiUpdateColors
function.description: This function updates the colors of a device context. It first gets the size of the device's color palette, then retrieves the window associated with the device context. If the size is non-zero and the window exists, it invalidates the window's current colors, causing them to be redrawn.

parameters.name: hDC
parameters.description: This is a handle to the device context whose colors are to be updated.

function.return_type: BOOL. This function returns TRUE if the colors were successfully updated, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: NtGdiSetMagicColors
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It always returns TRUE.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to a device context.

parameters.name: magic
parameters.description: A 32-bit unsigned integer, usage not defined in the stub function.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: A 32-bit unsigned integer, usage not defined in the stub function.

function.return_type: BOOL, always returns TRUE in this stub function.

function.name: NtGdiDoPalette
function.description: This function performs various operations on a palette based on the 'func' parameter. It can animate, set, get palette entries, get system palette entries, set and get DIB color table.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the GDI object

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The starting index for the operation

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of entries to be processed

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: Pointer to the entries to be processed

parameters.name: func
parameters.description: Determines the operation to be performed on the palette

parameters.name: inbound
parameters.description: Indicates whether the operation is inbound or not

function.return_type: LONG, represents the status of the operation. Returns 0 in case of an invalid 'func' parameter
